scripts.package:web-dashboard: npm run build && mkdir -p ../web/client/public/extension && python3 -c "import pathlib, zipfile; src=pathlib.Path('dist'); out=pathlib.Path('../web/client/public/extension/smartspecpro-marketplace-extension.zip'); out.unlink(missing_ok=True); z=zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(p, p.relative_to(src)) for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]; z.close()"
